decisive_spans.text: Cell differential: 1% lymphocytes, 1% monocytes/macrophages, 98% atypical cells/blasts

response.rationale: Leukemia is strongly supported by the presence of 'violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis)' and '98% atypical cells/blasts' in the CSF, which are highly indicative of leukemia. Lymphomatous Meningitis is also supported by the atypical cells and nodular thickening, but the 'leukemia cutis' points more specifically to leukemia.
